items.title: Asia Cup failures rooted in weak pipeline
items.summary: Women’s cricket has grown rapidly in recent years, and the Asia Cup highlighted not only Bangladesh’s in-game limitations but also the lack of growth behind them, largely stemming from a weak domestic pipeline.

items.title: Shafali, Deepti power India into sixth T20 Asia Cup final
items.summary: Both teams were sub-par with their fielding, but India comfortably prevailed over Bangladesh in Dubai

items.title: DPL shifted early for rain-free World Cup build-up
items.summary: With the ICC World Cup scheduled to be held in Africa from October 4 to November 21 next year and Bangladesh almost certain to secure a direct berth based on their ranking, preparations for the global showpiece are already underway.

items.title: Pakistan or Sri Lanka in the final? 'Doesn't matter,' says Deepti Sharma
items.summary: "I think that it will be a day here or a day there, it happens," Deepti Sharma says after India had another poor fielding day in the Women's T20 Asia Cup semi-final against Bangladesh

items.title: Bangladesh bow out after another India defeat
items.summary: Bangladesh’s chase never looked convincing from the outset, as the batters appeared more focused on avoiding a heavy defeat than seriously pursuing the 150-run target.

items.title: Bangladesh bowl against India, both teams unchanged
items.summary: India captain Harmanpreet said that she wanted to bat first anyway

items.title: Hasan Mahmud nominated for ICC Player of the Month for August
items.summary: Bangladesh pacer Hasan Mahmud has been nominated for the ICC Men’s Player of the Month award for August 2026 after a memorable tour of Australia, alongside England pacer Ollie Robinson and Sri Lanka batter Sonal Dinusha.

items.title: Tigresses look to Marufa in crunch semifinal against India
items.summary: Bangladesh pacer Marufa Akter has been in rich form in the Asia Cup, and ahead of Thursday’s crunch semifinal against India, she is hoping the senior players can continue making valuable contributions as they have throughout the tournament.

items.title: Tahir five-for, Sampson's sixes seal top spot for Guyana Amazon Warriors
items.summary: Imran Tahir and CPL debutant Mehidy Hasan Miraz took combined figures of 8 for 30 to subdue St Lucia Kings

items.title: Bangladesh bank on bowlers in bid to bring India down
items.summary: Bangladesh will hope to test a shaky Indian middle order in sweltering conditions in Dubai

items.title: Marufa, spinners step up to seal Bangladesh's semi-final spot
items.summary: Sharmin Akhter earlier rescued Bangladesh from the depths of 55 for 6 to 103 for 7 before the bowlers kept UAE to 69

items.title: CPL: Mehidy, Mohammad Haris set to join Amazon Warriors
items.summary: Mehidy Hasan Miraz will replace Mohammad Nabi, while Mohammad Haris will join the squad in place of Rahmanullah Gurbaz

items.title: Andersson 129* holds up Kent's promotion push
items.summary: Derbyshire recover after Hasan Mahmud strikes with first two balls of match

items.title: UAE bowl against Bangladesh in must-win game
items.summary: UAE made one change while Bangladesh made two

items.title: Dhaka and Sylhet to host West Indies for two-Test series in October-November
items.summary: West Indies will return to Bangladesh for their first Test tour of the country in five years
